hint.reason: Recorded in the audit log. Example: suspend at customer request (ticket #123). Up to 500 characters.
hint.tags: Separate with commas, up to 50 items.
hint.ipNames: Separate with commas, up to 50 items.
hint.imageAlt: Describe the image for people who cannot see it.
hint.users: All registered members. Open to review status.
hint.failed: Review failures and retry when safe.
hint.cleanup: Files awaiting automatic cleanup. No action required.
confirmImpact.projects: Hidden from the member’s project and session lists. Files, assets and verification records are preserved and can be restored. Running job results may not be applied.
confirmImpact.partners: Immediately removed from the public catalog and recommendations. Existing project links and past recommendations are preserved.
confirmImpact.monitoring: Hidden from the member’s monitoring list. Scan history is preserved.
confirmImpact.image: Immediately removed from the public catalog. Files will be deleted by cleanup. This cannot be undone.
confirmImpact.suspend: Immediately signed out and blocked from signing in. Data is preserved.
confirmImpact.cancel: Requests cancellation. External processing and billing may still complete.
confirmImpact.visibility: Public partners appear in the catalog and recommendations. Private partners are hidden.
confirmImpact.restore: Restores an archived record or suspended member. Partners are restored as private.
confirmImpact.language: Enables or hides the language in the selector. Translation data is preserved. The default language (ko) cannot be disabled.
confirmImpact.unpublish: Users of this language see the original (ko). The draft is preserved.
done.archive: Archived. Restore it from the archived list.
done.cancel: Cancellation requested. Check the job status for external processing outcomes.
done.imageRemoved: Image removed and file cleanup scheduled.
